name: Beibu Gulf Port Co., Ltd.
summary: Beibu Gulf Port Co., Ltd. provides port loading, unloading, storage, and related supporting services for containers, metal ores, and other cargoes in China. It offers berthing, loading and unloading services for shipping companies; container storage services for shipping companies and cargo owners; container lifting services for trucking companies; and container deconsolidation, consolidation, and repair services. The company also provides loading, unloading, and storage of bulk cargo within the port area; tugboat and other services; cargo and container tallying for shipping routes; container loading and unloading tallying; and cargo information consultation.
